Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `voxprint_common-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.4.0 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.4.0/voxprint_common-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl (tag commit eb5df2386564b302174b6fb66b2e6683a458e06e; sha256 `97a055750f4765d76567c110f50171afebfe5a541f90887105466c2f9bd6a63a`, also in the `.sha256` sidecar). It bundles the same serial 9 signed model index as 0.3.1 (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f), the voxprint-model/1 schema (sha256 e46ae56a…5138), the voxprint-app-models/1 schema (sha256 ed451b99…c420), and our index public key (`keys/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.4.0`. From 0.4.0, `paths.read_home()` no longer falls back to the legacy home (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Voxprint`, `~/.local/share/voxprint`); the Windows setup moves it first (`installer/windows/migrate-home.ps1`), and Model Forge only uses `paths.home()`-based helpers, which migrate on first use.
